text: Homotopy equivalence f: X→Y means there exists g: Y→X such that:
choices: f∘g = id_Y and g∘f = id_X (strict inverses)
f∘g ≃ id_Y and g∘f ≃ id_X (homotopic to identities)
f is a weak homotopy equivalence
explanation: Homotopy equivalence: f∘g and g∘f are homotopic (not necessarily equal) to identities.
